_comment: The policy discovery runs under against MERIDIAN CORE. Declared here as
reviewable data, not assembled from CLI flags: an allowlist a caller can
extend is not an allowlist. --allow-path may only NARROW this set.
This file is deliberately separate from config/app_profiles/meridian.json.
A profile describes what the application IS; a policy declares what the
agent may DO to it. Collapsing the two would bury a safety decision inside
allowed_paths covers sign-on, the menu, member inquiry and the member
/settings          the fault-injection console -- the agent must not be
able to change the application's own error behaviour
.../transfer/post  and every other post endpoint. Note that fnmatch's *
crosses /, so a bare /members/* would have permitted
every irreversible endpoint under it. The paths below
are written to end where the flow ends.
allowed_actions omits nothing the vocabulary offers except that the
recorder narrows the emitted artifact to the actions actually used.
